deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution to the intended recipient as part of enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Reimburse the Ikigai Info governance action submitter for an unrecovered governance action deposit plus estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the Cardano treasury to reimburse a lost 100,000 ADA governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The community expressed significant sentiment at the time that the Ikigai deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included the reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposal states the recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The proposal states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal states distribution can be audited on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The proposal provides an external adastat.net governance reference for the related Ikigai governance action.

summary: The document asks for a 103,000 ADA treasury withdrawal to reimburse a claimed unrecovered governance action deposit and estimated staking rewards, but most key factual and economic claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
